findings.finding: The plan's protection against vacuous guards is to make assert_no_detached_upkeep fail if os.environ has GIT_TEST_MAINT_AUTO_DETACH=false. That check is a proxy, and it does not reach all the guards. tests/unit/test_init_leaves_no_detached_upkeep.py builds its own `--detach` filter from maintenance_children() and never calls assert_no_detached_upkeep. If that file's delenv is ever dropped, it passes vacuously with no protection. The os.environ probe also cannot tell what git actually saw: env dicts built elsewhere, other falsy spellings, or a global/system autoDetach=false. The repo already has a stronger pattern for exactly this problem. test_bridge_fsck_keyset_prev.py runs an unpinned control commit and asserts that it detaches before judging the pinned path, which proves the trace can see a daemon whatever channel forced foreground mode.
scenarios: Someone refactors test_init_leaves_no_detached_upkeep.py and drops the delenv: the test keeps passing with no `--detach` children, because the session variable forces foreground maintenance, and nothing flags it.
A host or CI runner has maintenance.autoDetach=false in its global gitconfig: the os.environ probe passes, and every guard passes vacuously.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a helper to tests/_git_upkeep.py, for example `assert_default_upkeep_detaches(tmp_path)`. It makes an unpinned throwaway repo, runs `git commit --allow-empty` under its own GIT_TRACE2_EVENT, and asserts a `--detach` maintenance child appears. Call it from assert_no_detached_upkeep and from test_init_leaves_no_detached_upkeep.py, so every guard proves that git's default detach behaviour is in effect whatever channel might have overridden it. Keep the os.environ check only as a clearer error message, if at all.

findings.finding: The fix and its regression test depend on git 2.47 or later, but the repo's declared git floor is 2.38, and the plan does not mention this. As I recall, GIT_TEST_MAINT_AUTO_DETACH was added in the same git 2.47 change that moved auto-maintenance detaching into the child's `--detach`/`--no-detach` argv. On git 2.38-2.46 the variable is ignored, and a commit's `git maintenance run --auto` child never carries `--detach`. So the new test's check that no child carries `--detach` passes on the pre-fix tree, and the acceptance criterion that it fails pre-fix holds only on newer git.
scenarios: A developer or CI cell runs git between 2.38 and 2.46: the new regression test passes whether or not conftest sets the variable, so a later removal of the setting goes undetected there.
Someone verifies the 'fails on pre-fix tree' acceptance criterion on an older local git and wrongly concludes that the test does not discriminate, or that it does.
findings.suggested_fix: In the new test, assert that at least one recorded `git maintenance run` child contains `--no-detach`, which is a positive fact, rather than only that none contains `--detach`. Gate the test with a skip on `git --version` below 2.47 that names the reason. Add one sentence to Approach noting that older git ignores the variable, and that the race this plan fixes, from worktree-prune in geometric auto-maintenance, only exists on newer git anyway.

Other projects fixed the same detached-maintenance race in test repos by setting gc.autoDetach and maintenance.autoDetach to false in every test gitconfig (agent-sh/tower-crane PR #316), and by pinning those keys in the fixture repo's local config (datalad PR #7946).
The plan itself says some guard tests already write `autoDetach = true` into their own global config, which shows the suite already controls global-config scope per test.
findings.finding: The rejected-alternatives list leaves out the fix other projects commonly use for this same race: a session-wide test global gitconfig (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL) that sets maintenance.autoDetach=false and gc.autoDetach=false. Like the env var, that would leave repo-local pins with higher precedence. Unlike the env var, it does not depend on a git-internal test knob or a minimum git version.

Evidence class: Partially-verified. The mechanism matches git's prepare_auto_maintenance as I remember it from 2.47 onward (the variable is a fallback when autoDetach is unset, and the child gets '--detach' or '--no-detach'). I did not check it against the installed git binary or its --help/source in this environment.
findings.finding: The plan depends on GIT_TEST_MAINT_AUTO_DETACH, an undocumented git variable meant for git's own tests, and on the '--detach' / '--no-detach' child argv. Both arrived only in newer git (around 2.47). The plan states no minimum git version and does not say what happens on older git. On older git the auto-maintenance child is a plain `git maintenance run --auto` with neither flag, and gc --auto detaches internally. In that case the new test's check that no child carries `--detach` passes without proving anything, while maintenance is still detached.
